note: Every name in private/account/.env.example that is NOT in .ci/config/bws-secret-map.json, with the reason it is not, RE-DERIVED rather than believed.
owner: Assertion 14 of .ci/scripts/quality/check_bws_map.py. 14a refuses an example key in neither the map nor here; 14b refuses an entry naming a key the example no longer has; 14c re-derives every entry against its own kind.
modelled_on: .ci/config/bws-unrequested.json, which established the rule that an exemption states a CHECKABLE claim or it is just a licence.
why_the_example_and_not_the_env: private/account/.env is untracked and CI never sees it, so no gate can read it. .env.example is tracked and carries every live key, which makes it the only CI-visible surrogate. 14a is what keeps it one.

kinds.machine-local: The correct value is a function of THIS machine: a path, a listening port, a URL derived from that port. `derive` must cite a file:line that exists and still mentions the name. Reds when someone moves the default into the store, or deletes the writer.
kinds.bootstrap: The root of trust for reading everything else, so it cannot come from the store. Re-derived by requiring the name to be ABSENT from bws-secret-map.json; the moment it is added that is a circularity, and this reds.
kinds.opt-in: A feature a developer switches on locally. Re-derived by requiring the name to appear COMMENTED OUT in .env.example and never active. No live entries today, because every opt-in name this repo has is already in the map.
kinds.alias: The example spells a name the store holds under a different one, deliberately. `store` must name an entry that really is in the map, which stops an alias row forgiving a read that resolves to nothing.
kinds.test-fixture: A committed test constant that is not a credential. Re-derived twice: `derive` must cite a line that still contains the name, and the name must be ABSENT from the map. A store entry under the same name is the D3 collision.
kinds.unreferenced: Assigned in .env.example and read by NOTHING. Debt, not an exemption: the disposition is DELETE. Re-derived by a real sweep, so the entry reds the moment a reader appears. Carries `expires`, or it becomes permanent.
kinds.deferred: It should MOVE to the store and has not, because seeding a value is operator-only. Carries `blocker` and a UTC `expires`. Reds when that date passes, whether or not anyone looked.

REDIACC_ACCOUNT_SERVER.reason: http://localhost:4800, and private/account/src/entry/dev-gateway.ts rewrites it on every gateway start with the port actually bound

DATABASE_PATH.reason: account.db, a relative path resolved against the local checkout

PORT.reason: 3000, a listening port for the standalone node entry; a property of this machine, not of the deployment

CI_MODE.reason: asserts what this process is; app.ts gates Turnstile on it, and a shared store cannot know

WEBAUTHN_RP_ID.reason: localhost; one third of the WebAuthn consistency triple

WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME.reason: Rediacc; kept local because the WebAuthn spec requires the origin's host to equal RP_ID, so splitting the triple across two stores is how the halves drift

WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN.reason: derived from the bound gateway port; the third of the triple

BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN.reason: root of trust; no bws verb mints or rotates a machine-account token, so it cannot come from the store it unlocks

STRIPE_E2E_WEBHOOK_SECRET.reason: the committed E2E webhook constant, in the clear at its own writer. Renamed off STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET so it cannot collide with the store's real signing secret (D3)

AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.reason: local dev is EU; the store holds the regional spelling and ci.yml already performs the same collapse

AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.reason: local dev is EU; same regional collapse as its key id

DESIGN_PARTNER_PROGRAM_ENABLED.reason: ACTIVE in .env.example and read by nothing in console, either submodule, or private/growth. Same class as R2_MEDIA_BUCKET (D2): DELETE it from .env.example and .env, do not seed it
